name: AppealSegmentationBuilder
tagline: RFM segments, ask strings and suppressions for direct appeals – with a live cost and income forecast.
description: A complete direct-appeal selection app for charities on Power Platform: RFM scoring and nine segments, ask strings from the highest previous gift, 14 suppression rules with a waterfall, budget cap, forecast per segment, commit, mail-house file with source codes and response tracking.
features: Mid-level, new, active, lapsing, lapsed, monthly and prospect segments
Ask strings with rounding, min/max and custom asks
14 suppression rules with hard rules and manual overrides
Budget cap that cuts the lowest expected value first
Forecast with editable response rates, break-even and ROI
Commit, mail file CSV, mark mailed and record responses
Undo, history notes and Power Fx events
